description:
Momentum isn’t created by big wins.
It’s created by repeated acts of courage.

Showing up when you don’t feel ready.
Making the call. Posting the idea. Taking the step.

Do that enough times and confidence shows up uninvited.
Not because you hoped for it.
But because you earned it.
transcript: We must get addicted to uncomfortable action. We must get addicted to courageously moving forward. Courage isn't moving forward in the absence of fear. Courage is moving forward even if you're a little scared, even if you've never done it before. And then shifting your mindset to say, I'm gonna go for this. And if I fail, congratulations. That means I'm pushing myself. Because if you haven't failed much, that means you're playing safe.
spoken_hook_0_3s: We must get addicted to uncomfortable action.
